PULSO TIERRA ANTO — CURRENT SOURCE: FOOD REPLACED BY ICE

The current app is the engine SHA-256 recorded in render-recipes.json and
source-files.json. bank.json is version 3 with 50 active samples. ice replaces
food at position 7; the other seven theme methods and existing recordings
are retained. No regional modifications from Sun were imported.

Nine preview MP3 files remain byte-identical to the prior published Anto
version. The Deshielo MP3 is copied byte for byte from Sun, without decoding
or re-encoding. Each track in render-recipes.json retains its original render
engine provenance. The former published renderer is preserved separately in
../retained-previews-engine/ for those unchanged preview origins; its food
entry is historical, not an active category of this app.

Current source files: atlas-audio.js, sonification-policy.js, bank.json,
prepare-sounds.py and render-recipes.json. Source snapshots retain their
project-relative path assumptions. Serve those exact scripts with the sample
assets whose URLs are listed in bank.json. Load the policy and bank before
the engine. To reproduce a track through Web Audio / OfflineAudioContext:

  const engine = new AtlasAudioEngine();
  engine.setVolume(recipe.masterVolume);
  engine.setHeartbeat(track.heart);
  const wav = await engine.exportWav(track.events, {
    duration: recipe.duration, music: track.music
  });

recipe is parsed render-recipes.json; track is its corresponding entry.
Select the renderer matching a track's originalRenderEngineSha256 to
reproduce the original published render, or the current engine to reproduce
current live playback. Browser/decoder implementations can cause numerical
differences; preserving source and events is not a promise of identical
floating-point results in every browser.

Deshielo original Sun asset and recipe are documented in ../ice-source/.
They use actual water drops recorded in a plate, an ice block crushed in a
studio, and real soft glockenspiel recordings: all CC0. The published preview
has heart:false and needs no heartbeat attribution. It is not a field
recording of a glacier. Cold-extreme tension is artistic and does not assert
that cold causes melting. Values are local temperature-anomaly examples
referenced to 1951-1980, not quantitative global warming/damage scenarios.

For exact delivered bytes, prepare-sounds.py copies the imported ice MP3
files and preview rather than re-encoding them. Imported hashes appear in
the public license registry and ice-source/provenance.json. The former nine
previews retain their existing bytes. Historical preview encoding used a
constant gain to input peak 0.8 plus final 60 ms fade, MP3/libmp3lame 160 kbit/s at
44.1 kHz; this does not change the app's original live mix.

The complete original Bukvic SF2 and notices remain in violin_sordino.tar.bz2
in the source ZIP. ../rebuild_samples.py reconstructs the five muted-violin
WAVs. ../fetch_cc0_sources.py reconstructs the separate CC0 wind palette.
The original muted samples, modified muted data and derived forest rendering
keep the included Artistic License Version 2.0beta4, October 2000, not Artistic
2.0 final and not CC0. Other packages retain their individual licenses. No QA
baseline fixture or temporary local HTTP bridge is included.
